description: Restyle DuoScreenSettingsActivity to match design image 08_PhoneDuo.png. The current screen already has all the needed sections and functionality (Shizuku status, pane count, pane pickers, layout preset, content scale, reset arrangement, end session). The restyle replaces the current Connection section + flat contentRow() list with the design's specific visual structure: a Shizuku status banner card with Grant button, a PANES section with 2/3 segmented selector and numbered pane rows, a LAYOUT section with 5 preset mini-diagram chips instead of a single cycle row, content size as 100/125/150/200% chip row instead of a dialog, and the SESSION section with a danger-styled End button. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: 1. Read context.json first. Read DuoScreenSettingsActivity.kt fully. Note: it uses AutoBridgeDesign.body/page/header/sectionLabel/contentRow/stack, and AutoBridgeDesign.dp(), which is an extension function Context.dp(Int). The Activity extends plain Activity, not ComponentActivity — all UI is programmatic Views (no Compose). DuoScreenPreset enum lives in duoscreen/src/main/java/dev/autobridge/duoscreen/layout/DuoScreenPresets.kt with entries EVEN_COLUMNS/WIDE_LEFT/WIDE_RIGHT/EVEN_ROWS/PIP, each has glyph and labelRes. DuoScreenStore holds pane count, preset, content scale, packages, layout. CONTENT_SCALES = [100, 125, 150, 200]. DuoScreenHost.onSettingsChanged() is the live-push, DuoScreenHost.release() ends the session.

2. Restructure the render() method. Keep the same AutoBridgeDesign.page/header/body pattern. New structure:

   a) HEADER (unchanged): title=duo_screen_title ('Duo screen'), subtitle=duo_screen_subtitle ('Run two or three apps side by side on the car display'), onBack → finish().

   b) SHIZUKU STATUS BANNER: Replace the two-row Connection section (Android Auto + Shizuku rows) with a single banner card. The design shows a warning-amber circle with '!' and 'Shizuku not available / Needed to launch apps into the panes and pass touches to them' + a trailing 'Grant' button. When Shizuku IS available, show a green check. Implementation: build a custom LinearLayout row with amber/green left circle icon, the title+subtitle text, and a trailing accent pill button 'Grant' (only when !shizukuReady). Remove the Android Auto connection row — the design image 08 does NOT show it (only Shizuku). The AA row is informational only (it exists nowhere else in the design) and its status is shown on Home already — removing it from this screen does NOT remove a feature, just duplicate info.
   Note: if unsure about removing the AA row, keep it as a small muted subtitle under the header. Decision: the design clearly shows only the Shizuku row in the status area, so do not show the AA row. This does NOT violate 'do not delete UI not marked REMOVE' because the AA status is NOT a setting — it's a status display that duplicates Home, and the design explicitly replaces the Connection section with just the Shizuku banner.
   Add new string: duo_screen_shizuku_grant EN='Grant' TH='อนุญาต'.

3. PANES SECTION (sectionLabel 'Panes'):
   a) Number of panes: replace the current single contentRow (title + subtitle + trailing '>') with a row showing the title on the left and a 2/3 segmented chip control on the right. Implementation: a custom LinearLayout row with title 'Number of panes' and a segmented control with chips '2' and '3', the active one highlighted with accent fill. Tapping sets DuoScreenStore.setPaneCount() + applied() + render(). The design shows the segmented as a pair of small rounded chips.
   b) Pane app pickers: keep the existing pane rows (Pane 1, Pane 2, optionally Pane 3) with their current picker dialog. Restyle: add a leading numbered circle badge (AutoBridgeDesign accent tinted), title 'Pane N', subtitle showing the chosen app name (or 'No app chosen'), trailing chevron. The existing code already builds these via a repeat loop with AutoBridgeDesign.contentRow — just ensure the badgeText shows the pane number and the accent matches. The 'AutoBridge browser' case already uses the duo_screen_self_pane string.
   Preference keys preserved: KEY_PANE_COUNT='pane_count', setPackage writes KEY_LAYOUT='layout'.

4. LAYOUT SECTION (sectionLabel 'Layout'):
   a) Layout preset: replace the single contentRow+AlertDialog with a visual row of 5 mini-diagram chips. Each chip is a small ~60dp-wide cell showing a mini-rect diagram (drawn programmatically or using Unicode block characters) and a label. The 5 presets: Even columns (◫), Wide left (◧), Wide right (flipped ◧), Stacked rows, Picture in picture. The selected one is highlighted with accent border. Tapping sets DuoScreenStore.setPreset() + applied() + render().
   Implementation: Build a HorizontalScrollView or a single-row LinearLayout. For each DuoScreenPreset.entries, draw a chip cell. The mini diagram inside: for simplicity, use a small Canvas-drawn view or, simpler, use small nested views (LinearLayout with colored rectangles). Each diagram is about 40x30dp. Approach: create a miniPresetDiagram(preset: DuoScreenPreset): View method that returns a small FrameLayout showing the preset's rects. The mini diagram for each:
     - EVEN_COLUMNS: two equal vertical rectangles side by side
     - WIDE_LEFT: left 60%, right 40%
     - WIDE_RIGHT: left 40%, right 60%
     - EVEN_ROWS (Stacked rows): two equal horizontal rectangles stacked
     - PIP: full rect with a small rect in the corner
   Each rectangle is an AutoBridgeDesign.surface(fill, radius, stroke) View. Active preset's diagram uses ACCENT fill; inactive uses SURFACE_RAISED with HAIRLINE stroke. Label below from preset.label(this). Active label uses ACCENT color, inactive uses TEXT_MUTED.
   Preference key preserved: KEY_PRESET='preset'.

5. CONTENT SIZE: Replace the contentRow+AlertDialog with a chip row showing 100% / 125% / 150% / 200%. Similar to the panes 2/3 segmented but with 4 options. Active chip has accent fill, others have SURFACE_RAISED background. Tapping sets DuoScreenStore.setContentScale() + applied() + render(). Show the label 'Content size in a pane' and the subtitle 'Higher gives the app more room and draws it smaller' above the chip row.
   Preference key preserved: KEY_CONTENT_SCALE='content_scale'.

6. RESET ARRANGEMENT ROW: Keep as a contentRow under the Layout section. Same title and subtitle (duo_screen_reset_layout, duo_screen_reset_layout_hint). Same logic: DuoScreenStore.resetLayout() + DuoScreenHost.onLayoutReset() + toast + render(). Just make sure it's styled as a tappable row with chevron.

7. SESSION SECTION (sectionLabel 'Session'):
   End duo screen now: restyle as a danger-accented row. The design shows red text on a dark-red-tinted card. Use AutoBridgeDesign.DANGER accent for the row text and a tinted danger background (AutoBridgeDesign.tint(DANGER, 0.10f) fill). The confirmEndSession() AlertDialog stays unchanged. Same strings duo_screen_end_session + duo_screen_end_session_hint.
   Preference: no key — this is an action, not a setting.

8. Add new string resources in duoscreen/src/main/res/values/strings.xml + values-th/strings.xml:
   - duo_screen_shizuku_grant  EN='Grant'  TH='อนุญาต'
   The rest of the strings already exist (duo_screen_panes_section, duo_screen_layout_section, duo_screen_session_section, duo_screen_content_scale, duo_screen_content_scale_hint, duo_screen_content_scale_value, etc.). Verify no new strings needed beyond the Grant button.
9. Confirm the build passes: ./gradlew testPersonalDebugUnitTest assemblePersonalDebug
acceptance_criteria: Duo screen page shows: Shizuku banner (with Grant button when not available), PANES section with 2/3 segmented control + pane picker rows, LAYOUT section with 5 mini-diagram preset chips + content-size chip row + Reset arrangement row, SESSION section with danger-styled End button.
The Shizuku banner shows amber/warning when not available, green/check when connected.
Preset chips show mini diagrams of the 5 layout patterns. Selected preset is accent-highlighted.
Content size chips show 100/125/150/200%. Selected value is accent-highlighted.
Every DuoScreenStore read/write call is preserved. Pane count, preset, content scale, packages, layout arrangement all use the same preference keys.
confirmEndSession() dialog and DuoScreenHost.release() path unchanged.
New EN+TH strings added; no existing string removed or renamed.
findings: Restyled DuoScreenSettingsActivity.render() to match 08_PhoneDuo.png design. Replaced Connection section (AA + Shizuku rows) with a single Shizuku status banner card with amber/green circle icon and a Grant pill button. Replaced pane-count cycle-tap row with 2/3 segmented control. Replaced preset AlertDialog with 5 mini-diagram chips drawn programmatically (EVEN_COLUMNS, WIDE_LEFT, WIDE_RIGHT, EVEN_ROWS, PIP). Replaced content-scale AlertDialog with 100/125/150/200% chip row. End session now uses a danger-tinted card. All DuoScreenStore read/write calls preserved. confirmEndSession() and DuoScreenHost paths unchanged. Added duo_screen_shizuku_grant string in EN+TH. Removed unused imports (RuntimeContextStore, ConnectionStatusText, AppR). SettingsUi helpers exist but are unused elsewhere in the codebase; stayed with inline AutoBridgeDesign builders to match the file's existing style. Build green: testPersonalDebugUnitTest + assemblePersonalDebug.
